meta.name: paid-ads-launch
meta.description: Plan and prepare a new paid-media campaign or cross-channel test before it can spend. Use when asked to create, launch, start, set up, or allocate budget to an advertising campaign on any supported platform.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在花钱之前把新广告投放的方案和各渠道预算规划好
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正准备上线新的付费广告或做跨渠道投放测试
copy.tagline_en: Plan a new paid campaign and its channel budgets before any spend
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're about to launch a paid ad campaign or cross-channel test

howto.what: 它会先核对转化目标、预算、落地页、批准人等门槛信息并诊断追踪，再输出一份标记 ready_for_review 的投放前简报，涵盖目标衡量、渠道结构、预算、实验设计；获批后才在支持平台创建暂停状态的广告。
howto.when: 当你要创建、启动或分配预算投放广告时接管；在转化目标、预算、落地页等门槛信息齐全之前，不会做投放计划。

say.text: 给 Meta 建个小预算测试，创建成暂停状态
say.note: 通过 Meta 运营技能创建，保持暂停。

say.text: 这几个渠道的预算怎么分？先给我看投放前简报
say.note: 会说明小预算分渠道的取舍。

howto.what_en: It checks conversion goal, budget, landing page and approver, diagnoses tracking, then returns a preflight brief marked ready_for_review. Ads are created only after approval, paused, on supported platforms.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to create, launch, set up or budget an ad campaign on a supported platform. Without conversion goal, budget, landing page and approver it won't build a spend plan.

say_en.text: Draft a preflight brief for a Google Search launch, $500 daily budget
say_en.note: It gates on missing inputs first.

say_en.text: Set up a small Meta test, create it paused, don't go live
say_en.note: Runs via the Meta operator skill.

say_en.text: How should I split budget across channels? Show the brief first
